rationale: One directly shared canonical INSERT to risk_holds is replaced by fixed authenticated QA owner. Owner independently checks most recent persisted risk assessment for the exact domain, subject and scope, insists on hold/block action and exact reason-code, and prevents replay from reopening a released hold using stale assessment. Checkout/payout amounts are re-derived from primary records, not caller input. SQL insert repeats latest-assessment and no-active-hold guards. Existing risk case workflows remain unchanged. Other four risk-tax SQL mutations retain exact literals/functions and re-attested source fingerprints. Production legal authority remains disabled.
